units.body_md:
Home-service operators running Hatch's AI agents across every lead source nearly doubled their appointment set rates, and now respond to every new lead within one minute, 24/7, without adding staff for nights and weekends.

Hatch, which joined Yelp this year, says more than 150 million leads have flowed through its platform for HVAC, plumbing, roofing, and general contracting companies, and it is expanding into handyman, home cleaning, masonry, moving, pest control, and pressure washing with an integration of OpenAI's GPT-Live-1 ([announcement](https://www.businesswire.com/news/home/20261001328494/en/Hatch-Surpasses-150-Million-Leads-Expands-AI-Agent-Platform-Into-New-Service-Categories)).

sources.title: Hatch Surpasses 150 Million Leads, Expands AI Agent Platform Into New Service Categories
